newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hubco price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hubco price target raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it raised its long-term price target for Hubco Inc to $29 from $25 while reaffirming its buy rating for the stock.

-- Hubco appears to be having an excellent quarter, with loan growth accelerating sharply, said Gruntal. Its stock has also been strong in the past few sessions after falling behind a rise in the bank index for most of 1996, said Gruntal.
-- Several rumors on a possible merger of Hubco do not have much credibility, said Gruntal.
-- Hubco is a commercial bank in New Jersey.
